 Harris County District Court
 Cause No. 2024-CV-0041
 Samantha Fowler, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Plaintiff's Original Petition
Filed:
November 22, 2024
Plaintiff's counsel:
Jennifer Williams, Conley & Stephenson Law Group
PARTIES
Plaintiff Smaantha Fowler is an individual residing in Texas who was the driver of a vehicle involved in the collision described
below. The Dfeendant is an automobile insurance company authorized to write policies in the State of Texas, which isseud a
policy of automobile liability and uninsured/underinsured motorist coverage under which Plaintiff seeks benefits and damages.
FACTS
On November 18, 2023, Pliantiff was lawfully stopped in traffic at an intersection in League City, Texas, when the vehicle
operated by the at-fault driver struck the rear of Plaintiff's vehicle. The impact was forceful enough to push Plaintiff's car forward
and caused significant damage to the rear bumper, trunk and tail assembly. Plaintiff reported the collision to law enforcement and
to Defendant, and Plaintiff submitted a claim under the applicable coverage. Plaintiff has cooperated with Defendant's
investigation at all times. Defendant has not paid the amounts owed under the policy.
NEGLIGENCE
The at-fault driver owed a duty to keep a proper lookout, to control speed, and to maintain a safe following distance. That driver
breached those duties by failing to stop in time and striking Plaintiff's stopped vehicle. Under Texas law, a rear-end collision with
a stopped vehicle gives rise to a presumption of negligence on the part of the following driver, and no comparative fault is
attributable to Plaintiff. Defendant, as insurer, is obligated under the policy and Texas law to pay sums its insured or the covered
driver becomes legally obligated to pay, and Defendant's refusal to pay constitutes a breach of its contractual duties.
DAMAGES
As a direct result of the collision, Plaintiff suffered whiplash injuries to the neck and upper back, including pain, stiffness,
reduced range of motion and headaches. Plaintiff has incurred medical expenses for examination, imaging and treatment, has lost
time from work, and continues to experience pain and limitation in daily activities. Plaintiff also sustained property damage to the
vehicle. Plaintiff seeks actual damages, prejudgment and postjudgment interest, court costs, and all other relief to which Plaintiff
is entitled, in an amount of $233,000.00.
